_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/damage/test_divided_damage.py. t_dd_burn is Pyrokinesis's sentence on a plain instant: 4 damage divided among any number of target creatures. t_dd_onslaught is Monstrous Onslaught's: X is the greatest power among creatures you control, read as the spell is cast. t_dd_ogre is a vanilla 4/4 to give that X a number, and t_dd_wall a 0/6 that survives every share so the damage marked on it can be read.

cards.name: Test Divided Burn
cards.oracle_text: Test Divided Burn deals 4 damage divided as you choose among any number of target creatures.

cards.name: Test Divided Onslaught
cards.oracle_text: Test Divided Onslaught deals X damage divided as you choose among any number of target creatures, where X is the greatest power among creatures you control as you cast this spell.
